{{Top|leg}}
A '''cave-unit''' was an [[Aganof]] social group. All Aganof born in the same cave were a tribe, known as a cave-unit. The eldest Aganof served as the [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] for the tribe, and thus their opinions carried most weight with the group.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
